title: Chinese Ramen Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with ramen noodles, shio ramen seasoning, and mellow Japanese flavors.
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add shio ramen seasoning and stir to combine.
Add mellow Japanese mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add cooked ramen noodles and toss to combine with mushroom and seasoning mixture.
Add japanese soy sauce and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
